quest.title: Flavor of the Month
quest.description: Brook from Springvale wants to create a new dish during the Windblume Festival.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Actually, I was planning to create a new dish based on the theme of the Windblume Festival — specifically, the "taste of the wind," and I'm currently preparing the necessary ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: I commissioned Allan to help me go to Brightcrown Canyon to hunt for the freshest meat, but he hasn't returned yet, even after so long...

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: At this rate, my ingredients won't be fresh any longer. Could you help me go to Brightcrown Canyon to see what the situation's like?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got you covered.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Thanks! I'll let you try out my new dish once you return!

dialogues.speaker: Allan
dialogues.text: I... I'm saved... Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Allan
dialogues.text: I never thought that hunting one forest boar could get this hairy...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the ingredients Brook wants...

dialogues.speaker: Allan
dialogues.text: Oh, did Brook send you? Well, I do have the fresh Raw Meat she wants with me.

dialogues.speaker: Allan
dialogues.text: But I got careless while pursuing the boar and alerted the nearby monsters by mistake.

dialogues.speaker: Allan
dialogues.text: I got what I came for, but I was also surrounded by monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Allan
dialogues.text: Could you deliver the meat to Brook, Traveler? I need to go into the city and get my wounds treated at the Cathedral first...

dialogues.speaker: Allan
dialogues.text: *sigh* Ah, Draff is going to give me an earful again, I just know it...

talks.objective: Return to Springvale and talk to Brook

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back. Have you brought the Raw Meat with you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it right here.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me see... It does seem very fresh indeed. I think this will do. This meat will serve as our main ingredient... Now we just need some condiment that brings out the "taste of the wind"...

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: And when we're talking about that... We can only be speaking of "Dandelion Seeds."

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Could you help me gather some Dandelion Seeds, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Great! I'll leave it to you then. I'm going to prepare this meat in the meantime. Once you've gathered those Dandelion Seeds, just bring them straight back to me.

talks.objective: Give a set of Dandelion Seeds to Brook

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Do you have the Dandelion Seeds ready?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Thank you. Everything's ready now.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Ah, right. This is for you. Please consider it my thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: But how should we prepare this food such that it will take up the "taste of the wind"?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Cooking, frying... Hmm, no, perhaps we should place the original flavor of the ingredients front and center, before scattering the Dandelion Seeds on once the dish is ready...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: You're... Oh, I remember you. You were Xiangling's assistant, weren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: The memories of our culinary duel are still fresh in my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: I may have lost to her the last time, but this time, I will create a dish that has the "taste of the wind." Then I'll take it and ask her for a rematch!

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: I specially commissioned an adventurer to help me go to Dragonspine and obtain some Chilled Meat for this dish.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: However, that adventurer — Schuster was his name, I think — has yet to return...

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: I've heard that Dragonspine is a very dangerous place. I wonder if he might have run into some trouble... Could you help me search for him?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I could do that, no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Thanks for your willingness to help. Make sure to light some fires to keep warm. Dragonspine is very cold, after all.

talks.objective: Go to Dragonspine and find Schuster

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: C—Cold... Why is it s—so cold...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: C—Can someone... Can someone help me make a fire?

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I—I've been revived...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Y—You lit the fire... Th—Thank you, good-hearted traveler... Thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: A little warmer, that's for sure. I'll be fine... I was originally commissioned to come here to obtain some Chilled Meat...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I started out trying to look for some on the outskirts of Dragonspine, but as I walked, I misplaced my tinder — and that was before I also got lost by mistake...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: If you hadn't arrived, I don't know what I would have done. You have my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what're you going to do about Brook's commission?

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Ah, so Brook sent you to find me, huh... *sigh* She must be beside herself right now, I imagine. But as it stands, I haven't the energy to travel all the way to give her this meat...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I'm sorry to ask this of you, Traveler, but could you help me deliver this Chilled Meat to her?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can count on me.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. As for me, I need to head down to that campsite in the foothills to get a bowl of hot soup...

talks.objective: Return to Springvale and talk to Brook

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Back with the meat, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Oh, that's great! Wait... what about Schuster? He isn't in trouble, is he?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, he should be alright.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: That's good. It's good that nothing serious happened. Once I've finished this dish, I should bring him a serving too, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Speaking of that, this Chilled Meat really is different from normal meat. Perhaps a dish made from it really will have that certain... boom shaka-laka...

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Still, I think that Dandelion Seeds will be needed to make something that bears the "taste of the wind."

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: But if we only do that, I feel that the result wouldn't be much different from any normal meat-based cuisine. We need some sort of decisive condiment.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Oh right! That's it! In truth, I've actually met Xiangling a few more times since our contest, and I heard about a dish known as Mushroom Slime Stew from her.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: I've never used such strange and curious ingredients before... However, amazing dishes require equally unique ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Traveler, if I might trouble you again, could you help me look for some Slime Condensate and some Dandelion Seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure thing.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Great, I'm counting on you, then. I'll continue to ponder my recipe here.

talks.objective: Give the Dandelion Seeds and Slime Condensate to Brook

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Have you gotten the Slime Condensate and Dandelion Seeds ready?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Wonderful. Now we can truly begin. Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: With this Chilled Meat and these two ingredients, I will surely be able to make a dish with true boom shaka-laka!

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, here's something. Take it as thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Why isn't he here yet...

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: This dish must evoke the Windblume Festival somehow...

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: I've heard of Chilled Meat from other chefs as well. It's said that this type of meat has a unique flavor...

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: With these ingredients, I hope to make a dish that has some of that boom-shaka-laka...
